National Special Projects Office 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/51/2025/081 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Institutional Building - Delhi Pkg-81" (buildings),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
 NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 21 Apr 2025 at a gross executed value
 
 of Rs. 4158.00 Lakh (Rupees 41.58 Crore Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and
 the workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Rahul Das. This certificate is issued for
 record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish
 past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 National Special Projects Office
